        "\n",
        "branch_summary = df.groupby(\"branch\").agg(\n",
        "    Revenue=(\"revenue\", \"sum\"),\n",
        "    Gross_Income=(\"profit\", \"sum\"),\n",
        "    Transactions=(\"invoice_id\", \"nunique\"),\n",
        "    Units_Sold=(\"quantity\", \"sum\"),\n",
        "    Average_Rating=(\"rating\", \"mean\")\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "payment_summary = df.groupby(\"payment\").agg(\n",
        "    Transactions=(\"invoice_id\", \"nunique\"),\n",
        "    Revenue=(\"revenue\", \"sum\")\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "weekday_order = [\n",
        "    \"Monday\", \"Tuesday\", \"Wednesday\",\n",
        "    \"Thursday\", \"Friday\", \"Saturday\", \"Sunday\"\n",
        "]\n",
        "# Make sure day_name exists\n",
        "if \"day_name\" not in df.columns:\n",
        "    df[\"day_name\"] = pd.to_datetime(df[\"date\"]).dt.day_name()\n",
        "weekday_sales = df.groupby(\"day_name\")[\"revenue\"].sum()\n",
        "weekday_sales = weekday_sales.reindex(weekday_order)\n",
        "\n",
        "rating_summary = (\n",
        "    df.groupby(\"product_line\")[\"rating\"]\n",
        "    .mean()\n",
        "    .sort_values(ascending=False)\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "best_product = product_sales.idxmax()\n",
        "best_branch = branch_summary[\"Revenue\"].idxmax()\n",
        "best_payment = payment_summary[\"Transactions\"].idxmax()\n",
        "best_day = weekday_sales.idxmax()\n",
        "best_rating_product = rating_summary.idxmax()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"=\" * 55)\n",
        "print(\"SUPERMARKET BUSINESS INSIGHTS\")\n",
        "print(\"=\" * 55)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"\\nHighest revenue product line: {best_product}\")\n",
        "print(f\"Revenue: {product_sales.max():.2f}\")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"\\nBest-performing branch: {best_branch}\")\n",
        "print(f\"Revenue: {branch_summary.loc[best_branch, 'Revenue']:.2f}\")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"\\nMost-used payment method: {best_payment}\")\n",
        "print(f\"Transactions: {payment_summary.loc[best_payment, 'Transactions']}\")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"\\nHighest revenue day: {best_day}\")\n",
        "print(f\"Revenue: {weekday_sales.max():.2f}\")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"\\nHighest-rated product line: {best_rating_product}\")\n",
        "print(f\"Average rating: {rating_summary.max():.2f}\")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nRECOMMENDATIONS\")\n",
        "print(\"1. Monitor the best-performing product categories.\")\n",
        "print(\"2. Compare branch performance to identify improvement areas.\")\n",
